title: Abjad: what your name adds up to
caption:
Your name has a number. Your Nani probably knew it.

Ilm-e-Adad uses the old Abjad system, where every letter carries a value. Urdu and Persian poets used it to hide years inside their verses. Add up the letters in your name, reduce it to one digit, and there's your number.

For fun and cultural curiosity: a mirror, not a prophecy.

Comment your name's number below. Who else got a 5?
